name: decision_reason
description: Decision.reason: why a judgement changed or which existing remediation/verification step produced the statement. Operational reason labels preserve source intent and statement identity; they do not supply evidence or assurance.

definitions.regression: A previously resolved finding is open again because a regression was introduced.
definitions.data_error: A new judgement corrects erroneous data in an earlier judgement.
definitions.schema_migration: A restatement is needed because of a schema migration; original statements remain immutable.
definitions.baseline_rewrite: An existing baseline restatement reason; it does not authorize rewriting historical bytes.
definitions.operator_error: A new judgement corrects an operator error.
definitions.candidate: An existing remediation work item was opened.
definitions.forked: Remediation reported a prepared source fork.
definitions.revalidated_fixed: Remediation reported that revalidation found the fix effective.
definitions.revalidated_still_vulnerable: Remediation reported that revalidation still found vulnerability.
definitions.pr_opened: Remediation reported an opened fix pull request.
definitions.merged: Remediation reported a merged fix; merging alone is not proof of resolution.
definitions.abandoned: Remediation reported that the work item was abandoned.
definitions.partially_resolved: Verification reported aggregate partial resolution; code-line attribution remains necessary.
definitions.unresolved: Verification reported that the finding remains unresolved.
definitions.new_approach: Verification reported that the remediation needs a different approach.
definitions.false_positive: Verification reported a false-positive claim; the reason alone grants no authority.
definitions.risk_accepted: Verification reported risk acceptance; the reason alone grants no authority.

standard.none: Project-defined vocabulary owned by the existing data model.
